name: Lesinurad

own_problems.text: Carries a boxed warning in United States

examples.title: A Phase 4 Safety and Efficacy Study to Evaluate Lesinurad 200 mg in Participants With Gout and Renal Impairment
examples.why: This action was a business decision \& not related to any efficacy, safety or clinical concerns with lesinurad.

summary: Lesinurad comes with a boxed warning in the United States, which is the strongest warning used for medicine. Based on a small computer model rather than tests on people, it received a medium risk score of 54 for the liver and a low risk score of 34 for the heart [M]. Additionally, a study evaluating the drug in patients with gout and kidney problems was stopped due to a business decision rather than safety concerns [4].
